gaps.sentence: So difficult ___ the exam that half the candidates failed.
gaps.explanation: So difficult was the exam that… — inversion for emphasis.

gaps.sentence: Try ___ she might, she couldn't restart the engine.
gaps.explanation: 'Try as somebody might' — fixed concessive inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: Only since the redesign ___ the app gained new users.
gaps.explanation: 'Only since the redesign has the app gained …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than the rumours started.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had … been signed than …' — past perfect with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the play cancelled, but the theatre was closed as well.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the play cancelled' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.
